visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen view. On the top, a woman with a nose ring and reddish hair is shown in a close-up, pouring brown instant coffee granules onto a metal palette. On the bottom, another woman with vivid green hair watches intently. The background for the bottom woman is a warm indoor room with a large, ornate golden clock. (2) The scene shifts as the green-haired woman becomes the main focus. She is wearing a grey tank top and stands in front of the same golden clock. She holds up a large glass jar of Nescafe instant coffee and begins pouring some into a small white plastic tray. (3) She then takes a white jar of lotion and adds a dollop to the coffee granules on the tray. She uses a small metal spatula to mix the two substances together until they form a thick, tan-colored paste. She looks at the mixture with a curious, slightly skeptical expression. (4) The woman applies a smudge of the coffee-lotion mixture to her cheek and begins blending it with her fingers. She covers one side of her face, showing the difference in skin tone. She continues to blend it across her entire face, occasionally making funny faces at the camera. (5) She picks up a yellow bag of M&Ms. She takes out a brown M&M, licks it, and then rubs the wet candy onto her eyelid, using it as an eyeshadow. She repeats this for both eyes, carefully looking into the camera. (6) Next, she takes a black pencil and dips the tip into a white ceramic cup containing hot water. She uses the softened pencil tip to draw eyeliner on her upper lids and fill in her eyebrows. (7) She opens a red bag of Skittles and selects a red candy. After licking it, she applies the red pigment to her lips and then uses another red Skittle to dab color onto her cheeks as blush, blending it out with her fingers. (8) The video concludes with the woman showcasing the final makeup look, which looks surprisingly natural. She gestures towards her face while holding the M&Ms bag, smiling and talking to the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting.
